'''Gilber''' is a quartermaster of [[Davram Bashere]], serving in [[Saldaea]]. He is full of banter.

== Activities ==
When [[Chel Vanin]] pokes fun of [[Madresin Mandevwin]], [[Faile Bashere|Faile]] is reminded of Gilber.{{ref/book|14|28}}

== Trivia ==
* Gilber is named for Chris Gilbert, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
